newsitem.title: JAPAN: Amway Japan plans to repurchase shares.
newsitem.headline: Amway Japan plans to repurchase shares.

text.p: Amway Japan Ltd said on Monday it was planning to buy back up to 750,000 of its shares worth a total of three billion yen.

The door-to-door seller of detergents, cosmetics and kitchenware said the repurchase was part of a plan approved at a regular shareholder's meeting in November to buy back up to three million shares worth 12 billion yen.
Amway said in a statement, however, that there was a possibility it may not carry out the buy back, depending on market conditions.
It said that if the initial buy back went as planned it would be made at market prices and the firm would then carry the rest of the buy backs through publicly offered bids at pre-determined prices.
In August 1996, the company bought back 2.8 million shares valued at 15 billion yen.
